title.narrative: Jakarta ICMPS 2022 YAYASAN AYO INDONESIA JAKARTA VDI122

description.narrative: The Towards more inclusive health and education services for People Living with Disability implemented by Ayo Foundation aims to contribute to improving the access of people living with disability (PLD) to essential health services at the Health Centres in the District of Manggarai, Flores, NTT. The objectives of the grant is to support a twelve-month programme aimed at improving the lives of people living with disabilities in one of Indonesia’s poorest, and least resourced provinces. The key activities include 1) improve policy attention on disability at district and local levels through information sessions; 2) train medical staff in disability care; 3) enhance disability-related data collection; and 4) consolidate and strengthen the groups of People Living with Disabilities (PLD) at the community level.
